item.title: Iran warns US, regional states of ‘painful’ attacks if they act against Tehran

item.title: Iran sends largest trade delegation in decade to Russia
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran has sent its largest trade delegation in the past decade to Russia, comprising about 30 government officials and 180 representatives of chambers of commerce, traders, and economic activists, an official at the Trade Promotion Organization of Iran (TPO) says.

item.title: Top security official: Trump foolishly continues the war, but Iran is fully ready for self-defense
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council Mohsen Rezaei says US President Donald Trump waged a foolish war on Iran and is foolishly continuing it. However, Iran stands ready to give a stronger and more painful response should the US resume military aggression, as it did during the 40-day conflict that began earlier this year.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86268682/Top-security-official-Trump-foolishly-continues-war-but-Iran

Tehran, IRNA – Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council Mohsen Rezaei says US President Donald Trump waged a foolish war on Iran and is foolishly continuing it. However, Iran stands ready to give a stronger and more painful response should the US resume military aggression, as it did during the 40-day conflict that began earlier this year.
